summary: Prefer unit tests for cases that are impossible, slow or hard to cover with integration tests: forcing rare failures, heavy testing of slow config APIs, or things that can't run in the main Azure Pipelines CI.
questions: When is a unit test better than an integration test for a module?
How do I test rare network failures in a module?

answer_card.title: When to choose unit tests
answer_card.answer_md:
Use unit tests when integration tests can't do the job well:
- forcing rare or random situations such as specific network failures and exceptions
- extensive testing of slow configuration APIs
- cases whose integration tests can't run in Ansible's main CI (Azure Pipelines)
